title: The Silent Cost of Conversation History in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn information systems accumulate their own earlier replies and a growing task state. We asked whether this conversation history lowers accuracy, and whether process-level quality metrics warn before it does. Each analysis was fixed before its outcomes were computed. In Study 1, on 48 sharded math tasks, retaining its replies lowered final success by 0.21 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.29 for Mistral-7B (Holm-adjusted p = 0.026 and 0.004); Llama-4 Scout showed the same direction, not significant. Study 2 introduces CDR-Stream, 100-turn state-tracking dialogues with an exact answer per turn and per-model difficulty calibration. With the full history, accuracy fell from about 0.6 to 0.1 within twenty turns at matched difficulty, whereas a solver-verified state summary kept it 0.52-0.59 higher (Holm-adjusted p less than 0.001). Consistency and logical coherence fell far less than accuracy, and stability rose

translated_title: LLM推理中对话历史的隐性代价
translated_abstract: 在多轮信息系统中，大语言模型（LLM）会不断累积自身早期的回复以及持续增长的任务状态。我们探究了这种对话历史是否会降低准确率，以及过程级质量指标能否在准确率下降之前发出预警。每项分析均在计算结果之前预先设定。在研究1中，针对48个分片数学任务，保留模型自身回复使GPT-4o-mini的最终成功率降低0.21，Mistral-7B降低0.29（经Holm校正的p值分别为0.026和0.004）；Llama-4 Scout呈现相同趋势，但不显著。研究2引入了CDR-Stream基准，包含100轮状态追踪对话，每轮均配有精确答案并针对各模型进行了难度校准。在相同难度下，使用完整历史时，准确率在二十轮内从约0.6降至0.1；而使用经求解器验证的状态摘要，准确率可保持高出0.52至0.59（经Holm校正的p值小于0.001）。一致性与逻辑连贯性的下降幅度远小于准确率，而稳定性反而有所上升。
tldr: 研究发现累积的对话历史会显著降低LLM在多轮任务中的推理准确率，且过程级质量指标无法提前预警这种下降，而用经求解器验证的状态摘要替代完整历史可挽回大部分性能损失。
en_tdlr: Accumulated conversation history silently degrades LLM reasoning accuracy across turns without warning from process-level quality metrics, while replacing full history with solver-verified state summaries recovers most of the lost performance.
